These files stand in for Riot's Data Dragon (`ddragon.leagueoflegends.com`), which this
environment cannot reach. They have Data Dragon's shape (`/api/versions.json`, and
`/cdn/<version>/data/en_US/champion.json` and `item.json`), cut to the champions and items the
tests use; the numbers are written by hand, from memory, and are not this patch's.
